{"content":"# Progress

## Milestones (Add more as needed)
- [x] M0 Plan
- [x] M1 Build
- [x] M2 Test
- [x] M3 README and final end-to-end check

## Decisions
- **Tech Stack**: React 18 + Vite + React Router v6 + Vitest + Testing Library
- **Styling**: CSS Modules (component-scoped) with CSS custom properties for theming
- **Structure**: Component-based architecture with pages, components, hooks, and data layers
- **Theme**: Dark magical theme with gold accents (Harry Potter aesthetic)

## Project Structure
```
src/
├── components/          # Reusable UI components
│   ├── Header/         # Navigation header
│   ├── Footer/         # Site footer
│   ├── Layout/         # Page layout wrapper
│   ├── SpellCard/      # Spell display card
│   ├── CharacterCard/  # Character profile card
│   ├── Timeline/       # Interactive timeline
│   ├── Quote/          # Quote display component
│   └── YearAccordion/  # Hogwarts year accordion
├── pages/              # Page components (routes)
│   ├── Home/           # Landing page
│   ├── Biography/      # Harry's life story
│   ├── HogwartsYears/  # Year-by-year breakdown
│   ├── Friends/        # Allies and friends
│   ├── Enemies/        # Villains and enemies
│   ├── Magic/          # Spells, wand, patronus
│   ├── Timeline/       # Interactive timeline
│   └── Gallery/        # Image gallery
├── data/               # Static data (JSON/JS)
│   ├── spells.js       # Spell database (30+ spells)
│   ├── characters.js   # Character database (30+ characters)
│   ├── timeline.js     # Timeline events (50+ events)
│   └── quotes.js       # Famous quotes (20+ quotes)
├── hooks/              # Custom React hooks
│   └── index.js        # useScroll, useMobileMenu, useLocalStorage, etc.
├── styles/             # Global styles
│   ├── variables.css   # CSS custom properties
│   ├── globals.css     # Global resets/base
│   └── animations.css  # Keyframe animations
├── utils/              # Utility functions
│   └── helpers.js      # Formatting, filtering, helpers
├── App.jsx             # Root component with routing
├── main.jsx            # Entry point
└── index.html          # HTML template
```

## Pages & Features
1. **Home** - Hero section, quick stats, featured quote, navigation cards
2. **Biography** - Early life, Hogwarts years summary, post-war life, quotes
3. **Hogwarts Years** - 7 years with expandable details per year, stats
4. **Friends & Allies** - Grid of character cards with filtering, houses info
5. **Enemies** - Voldemort, Death Eaters, dark arts info, filtering
6. **Magic** - Wand, Patronus, Parseltongue, spells database with categories
7. **Timeline** - Interactive vertical/horizontal timeline with search/filter
8. **Gallery** - Masonry grid with modal detail view for characters, locations, items, creatures

## Components Built
- Header with responsive navigation (hamburger menu on mobile)
- Footer with links and copyright
- Layout wrapper with scroll restoration
- SpellCard (name, incantation, effect, type, color-coded)
- CharacterCard (name, house, blood status, role, image placeholder)
- TimelineEvent (date, title, description, icon, expandable)
- Quote display with attribution
- YearAccordion for Hogwarts years

## Data Requirements
- 30+ spells with categories (Charms, Transfiguration, Defense, etc.)
- 30+ characters (friends, enemies, mentors, family)
- 50+ timeline events from birth to epilogue
- 20+ famous quotes with book/chapter references

## Testing Strategy
- Unit tests for utility functions (Vitest)
- Component tests for key components (React Testing Library)
- Data validation tests
- Hook tests

## Accessibility & Performance
- Semantic HTML5
- ARIA labels and roles
- Keyboard navigation
- Focus management
- Reduced motion support
- Lazy loading ready
- Code splitting by route

## Notes / Known Issues
- Gallery uses placeholder icons instead of actual images
- Character detail pages not implemented (only cards)
- No actual backend - all data is static
- Some CSS animations may be complex for older browsers","path":"/kaggle/working/Website/docs/PROGRESS.md"}

{"path":"/kaggle/working/Website/README.md","content":"# Harry Potter Website

A comprehensive, interactive personal website for Harry Potter — The Boy Who Lived. Explore his life, magic, friends, enemies, and legacy through an immersive, magical web experience.

![Harry Potter Website](public/og-image.jpg)

## Features

### 📖 Biography
Complete life story from the cupboard under the stairs to the defeat of the Dark Lord, with key facts, timeline, and memorable quotes.

### 🏰 Hogwarts Years
Interactive year-by-year breakdown of all seven years at Hogwarts, including:
- Key events and milestones
- Characters met
- Spells learned
- Outcomes and consequences

### 🤝 Friends & Allies
Detailed profiles of 30+ characters including:
- The Golden Trio (Harry, Ron, Hermione)
- Order of the Phoenix members
- Dumbledore's Army
- Hogwarts staff and house ghosts
- Filterable by house, role, and search

### 🐍 Enemies
Comprehensive database of dark forces:
- Lord Voldemort and his Horcruxes
- Death Eaters (Bellatrix, Lucius, etc.)
- Ministry antagonists (Umbridge)
- Dark creatures (Dementors, Basilisk, etc.)
- Unforgivable Curses explained

### ⚡ Magic & Spells
Harry's complete spellbook with 30+ spells:
- Signature spells (Expelliarmus, Expecto Patronum, etc.)
- Categorized by type (Charms, Defense, Transfiguration, etc.)
- Difficulty ratings and incantations
- Wand details (Holly, Phoenix feather, 11")
- Patronus (Stag) and Parseltongue ability

### 📜 Interactive Timeline
Chronological journey from 1980–2017 with:
- 50+ major life events
- Vertical and horizontal view modes
- Filter by category (Personal, Hogwarts, Quidditch, Magic, etc.)
- Full-text search
- Expandable event details

### 🖼️ Gallery
Visual exploration of the wizarding world:
- Characters, Locations, Magical Items, Creatures
- Masonry/Grid view modes
- Modal detail view with descriptions
- Category filtering

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: React 18 with Vite
- **Routing**: React Router v6
- **Styling**: CSS Modules with CSS Custom Properties
- **Testing**: Vitest + React Testing Library
- **Data**: Static JSON/JS modules
- **Icons**: Unicode emoji (no external dependencies)

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+
- npm 9+

### Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone <repository-url>
cd harry-potter-website

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Start development server
npm run dev

# Run tests
npm test

# Build for production
npm run build

# Preview production build
npm run preview
```

## Project Structure

```
harry-potter-website/
├── public/
│   ├── favicon.svg
│   └── og-image.jpg
├── src/
│   ├── components/       # Reusable UI components
│   │   ├── Header/
│   │   ├── Footer/
│   │   ├── Layout/
│   │   ├── SpellCard/
│   │   ├── CharacterCard/
│   │   ├── Timeline/
│   │   ├── Quote/
│   │   └── YearAccordion/
│   ├── pages/            # Route components
│   │   ├── Home/
│   │   ├── Biography/
│   │   ├── HogwartsYears/
│   │   ├── Friends/
│   │   ├── Enemies/
│   │   ├── Magic/
│   │   ├── Timeline/
│   │   └── Gallery/
│   ├── data/             # Static data
│   │   ├── spells.js
│   │   ├── characters.js
│   │   ├── timeline.js
│   │   └── quotes.js
│   ├── hooks/            # Custom React hooks
│   │   └── index.js
│   ├── styles/           # Global styles
│   │   ├── variables.css
│   │   ├── globals.css
│   │   └── animations.css
│   ├── utils/            # Utility functions
│   │   └── helpers.js
│   ├── test/             # Test setup
│   │   └── setup.js
│   ├── App.jsx
│   ├── main.jsx
│   └── index.html
├── index.html
├── package.json
├── vite.config.js
└── README.md
```

## Design System

### Color Palette
- **Background**: Dark magical theme (`#0a0a12`, `#12121f`, `#1a1a2e`)
- **Gold Accent**: Primary brand color (`#ffd700`, `#b8860b`)
- **House Colors**:
  - Gryffindor: `#740001` / `#ae0001`
  - Slytherin: `#0d6217` / `#1a7a2a`
  - Ravenclaw: `#0e1a40` / `#222f5b`
  - Hufflepuff: `#ecb939` / `#f0c75e`

### Typography
- **Primary**: Georgia, serif (body text)
- **Secondary**: Cinzel, serif (headings)
- **Monospace**: Fira Code (code/incantations)

### Animations
- Floating, sparkling, glowing effects
- Scroll reveal animations
- Reduced motion support via `prefers-reduced-motion`

## Accessibility

- Semantic HTML5 elements
- ARIA labels and roles
- Keyboard navigation support
- Focus management
- Skip to main content link
- Color contrast compliance
- Reduced motion support
- Screen reader optimized

## Data Sources

All content is based on the seven Harry Potter novels by J.K. Rowling:
1. *Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone* (1997)
2. *Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets* (1998)
3. *Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban* (1999)
4. *Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire* (2000)
5. *Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix* (2003)
6. *Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince* (2005)
7. *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows* (2007)

## Disclaimer

This is a fan website created for educational and entertainment purposes. Harry Potter characters, names, and all related indicia are trademarks of Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. and J.K. Rowling. This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Warner Bros., J.K. Rowling, or any official Harry Potter entity.

## License

MIT License - feel free to use for learning and personal projects.

## Contributing

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch
3. Make your changes
4. Run tests (`npm test`)
5. Submit a pull request

## Acknowledgments

- J.K. Rowling for creating the Wizarding World
- The Harry Potter Wiki for reference data
- React, Vite, and Vitest communities"}

## Summary

### 1. User's Requests and Goals
- **Original SPEC**: "Create a personal website for Harry Potter. Make it super cool and indepth with information"
- **Tech Stack Decision**: React 18 + Vite + React Router v6 + Vitest + Testing Library (chosen by assistant since user was non-interactive)
- **Styling**: CSS Modules with CSS custom properties for theming

### 2. Key Facts Discovered
- **Project Structure**: `/kaggle/working/Website/` with standard React/Vite structure
- **Data Files Created**:
  - `src/data/spells.js` - 465 lines, 40+ spells with categories, incantations, effects
  - `src/data/characters.js` - 528 lines, 25+ characters with houses, roles, relationships
  - `src/data/timeline.js` - 696 lines, 50+ chronological events from birth to epilogue
  - `src/data/quotes.js` - 522 lines, 60+ memorable quotes
- **APIs/Commands Working**:
  - `npm install` - dependencies installed successfully
  - `npm run build` - builds successfully (exit code 0)
  - `npm test` - runs Vitest, 84 tests pass, 2 failing (useLocalStorage hook tests)
- **Errors Resolved**:
  - Fixed import paths for components (added explicit file paths)
  - Fixed CSS module class name concatenation issues
  - Fixed build errors from missing exports and incorrect class names

### 3. Changes Made (Files Created/Edited)
**Core Config**: `package.json`, `vite.config.js`, `index.html`, `public/favicon.svg`
**Styles**: `src/styles/variables.css`, `globals.css`, `animations.css` (1000+ lines total)
**Data**: 4 data files + 3 test files
**Hooks**: `src/hooks/index.js` + test file
**Components** (10 reusable components):
- Header, Footer, Layout
- SpellCard, CharacterCard, Timeline, Quote, YearAccordion
**Pages** (8 pages):
- Home, Biography, HogwartsYears, Friends, Enemies, Magic, Timeline, Gallery
**Tests**: 5 test files covering utils, data, hooks

### 4. Decisions and Preferences
- **Architecture**: Component-based with clear separation (components/pages/data/hooks/utils)
- **Routing**: React Router v6 with Layout wrapper
- **Theming**: Dark magical theme with gold accents, CSS custom properties
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first with breakpoints at 768px, 1024px, 1200px
- **Accessibility**: ARIA labels, semantic HTML, skip links, reduced motion support

### 5. Current State
- **Completed**: M0 (Plan) ✓, M1 (Build) ✓ - website builds successfully
- **In Progress**: M2 (Test) - 84/86 tests passing

  - M3: Create README and final end-to-end check
